name: The Mosaic Cloud Palace
description: A palace constructed from floating colored clouds shaped into arches and towers, each cloud contains tiny golden windows that emit soft light at dusk.
prompt: A breathtaking Mosaic Cloud Palace: floating clouds molded into architectural forms, each cloud containing golden windows that glow at dusk, pastel sky backdrop, dynamic composition, luminous, fantasy scenery.
caption: Step into the Mosaic Cloud Palace—where the very sky forms a home of light and color ☁️🏰.
